title: Licensing and attribution: GPL-3.0, LGPL-2.1, MIT, SPDX headers
summary: Record the owner decision. The application and the workspace default are GPL-3.0-or-later. The core crates are LGPL-2.1-or-later. kate-syntax is MIT. Add the license texts, SPDX headers, NOTICE, AUTHORS, and a GPL-3.0 section 7(b) attribution term. Add a test that fails when a Rust file has no header. PKT-0002 through PKT-0013 depend on this packet because they edit the same files. No editor behavior.

lane.reason: The owner already chose the license split. This packet writes that choice into the tree. It needs the owner name and a review of the section 7 term.

definitions.definition:
[workspace.package]
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"

# apps/katem5rust/Cargo.toml and tools/gatecheck/Cargo.toml
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"

# crates/kate-text, kate-fileio, kate-search, kate-core
license = "LGPL-2.1-or-later"

# crates/kate-syntax/Cargo.toml
license = "MIT"

| Path | SPDX-License-Identifier | Cargo.toml license |
|---|---|---|
| apps/ and tools/ | GPL-3.0-or-later | GPL-3.0-or-later |
| crates/kate-text, kate-fileio, kate-search, kate-core | LGPL-2.1-or-later | LGPL-2.1-or-later |
| crates/kate-syntax | MIT | MIT |

Header, first lines of every .rs file:
SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 John Valdez
SPDX-License-Identifier: <the identifier in the table>

GPL-3.0 section 7(b) additional term, in LICENSE and NOTICE. It is a permitted additional term. It is not a further restriction under section 10. Anyone who distributes a modified version of a GPL-3.0-or-later part must keep this attribution in the About box or in equivalent Appropriate Legal Notices: Based on KateM5Rust by John Valdez, a Rust rewrite of KDE Kate

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: No editor API changes. gatecheck gains expected_spdx_license and check_rust_spdx_headers. Every Cargo.toml gains a license field. The repository gains LICENSE, LICENSES/, NOTICE, and AUTHORS.

regression_tests.name: spdx_headers::every_rust_file_has_the_header_for_its_crate
regression_tests.asserts: Every .rs file under apps, crates, and tools has the copyright line and the license line for that crate. A file with no header fails the test.

regression_tests.name: spdx::tests::prefix_map_matches_the_owner_split
regression_tests.asserts: kate-syntax maps to MIT. kate-text maps to LGPL-2.1-or-later. apps and tools map to GPL-3.0-or-later. An unknown path maps to None.
